notes.title: 🐣🐴 November Update 🐣🐎
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37259037/0ac491b4d1b843da466a3678da7c735e35568e36.png

✨Motion blur switched off
✨2 different levels of difficulty can be selected
✨Horses are now taken care of when the player is asleep
✨All items that the horses take care of now do so with double the amount.
✨In the stable, horses are taken care of every 4 minutes if you have all the resources in stock
✨Invert mouse option added
✨The change of the gamma setting to Num 7-9 are now also displayed as an on-screen message
✨Flashlight can now be found in the house
✨All light sources made a little brighter
✨Taming wild horses is now much cheaper

Have fun playing

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1265690/Horse_Riding_Deluxe_2/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37259037/0e597b7c70f8475dcb3c97feb15b1943d6d0246c.png

notes.title: 🥳🐣🐴 Big Update & Release 🐣🐎😍
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37259037/0ac491b4d1b843da466a3678da7c735e35568e36.png

New:
✨	26 new quests
✨	5 new racetracks
✨	4 different stables can be selected
✨	Gamma settings with Num7 and Num8 (Num9 = Reset)

Changes:
✨	Race track names are now displayed on the map
✨	Loading time after map is shorter

Fixes:
✨	Player can no longer fall through the floor after loading
✨	Quest objectives were sometimes not visible when accepting the quest, that no longer happens
✨	Dog names are now displayed in the items

Have fun playing 😊

notes.title: 🐎Update Nr. 3🐴🐕
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37259037/0ac491b4d1b843da466a3678da7c735e35568e36.png
🐎Update Nr. 3🐴🐕

- 13 new quests
- 3 new racetracks
- 2 new dogs + dog training which will help you collect items directly (quest reward)
- Bag as expansion of inventory (quest reward)
- Player's footstep sounds changed
- jump height of the horses made a little lower
- Added a sign to the stables. Where you can call your bought / tamed horses and also buy all dogs.
- Horse values (e.g. B: Hunger, disease,...) are no longer influenced by open menu. But the menu doesn't quite pause the game, if you want to pause the whole game you can do it with the ′′ P ′′ button.
- Some people didn't take care of horses in the stable, although there were enough resources in stock, that shouldn't happen anymore.

Have fun playing :)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37259037/e4d29bf38188e401d4ce58cfca6c3f806a70c4c3.jpg

notes.title: 🐴 Update Nr. 2 🐎
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37259037/0ac491b4d1b843da466a3678da7c735e35568e36.png
- 3 new racetracks

- 3 additional chests

- When the HRD Coins is surrendered, an effect appears so that it is clearer when a reward is put on the ground.

- With the HRD Coin rewards that are pets, the animal will no longer be called immediately. (Which led to the player having dogs, but couldn't send them away unless the HRD Coin reward was collected. ))

- Some people have lost the player or horse, that's not happening anymore.

- Items no longer duplicate in chest.

- Horses can no longer stand on the stable roof.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37259037/d9fbdad5900f963bfc9c6118819f40983137cbc1.jpg

notes.title: 🐎 Update Nr. 1 😊
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37259037/0ac491b4d1b843da466a3678da7c735e35568e36.png
🐎 Update Nr. 1 😊

- 3 new racetracks
- Game character now has a smaller hitbox
- Reading time adjusted for quests
- Some texts and translations revised
- Some info question marks have been changed in radius
- You get more resources from the bags and there is a chance to get + 10 unique
- Additional HRD coins distributed
- Mapmarker now also show the distance
- NPC running speed changed
- Changed text when collecting resources
- Cleaning hooves adapted animation

🐴 Have fun playing :)
